summary: The heading area at the top of a settings-style page, with a title and optional description.
description: A header component for providing context about a specific page: a heading, optional icon, badge, description, support link, back button, and breadcrumbs.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Secondary text shown under the heading.

attributes.name: iconSrc
attributes.description: Src for an optional icon shown next to the heading.

attributes.name: supportPage
attributes.description: Optional SUMO support page slug (attribute: support-page) for a related support article link.

attributes.name: backButton
attributes.description: Whether the header includes a back button; fires navigate-back when clicked.

attributes.name: badge
attributes.description: Includes a moz-badge of this type with matching text. Options: beta, new.

attributes.name: headingLevel
attributes.description: Heading level to render (1-6). Defaults to 2.

slots.name: breadcrumbs
slots.description: Container for a moz-breadcrumb-group, shown above the heading.

events.name: navigate-back
events.description: Fired when the back button is clicked, indicating backwards navigation should occur.
